$comment: The one source of the /wf key surface. scripts/generate.mjs writes the key tables of SKILL.md, the key count of route.md, the README key table, the manifest descriptions and agents/openai.yaml from this file. Edit this file, then run npm run generate. A host value is "full", "differs: <how>" or "gap: <reason>".

keys.name: intake
keys.does: Entry dispatcher. A description starts stage 1. A mode ({entryModes}) runs an entry flow. An existing slug plus a mode attaches a compressed slice; a slug plus free scope extends the workflow. A slug plus {maintenanceModes} edits, backfills or closes the workflow or one slice.
keys.summary: Entry dispatcher. A description starts stage 1; a mode ({entryModes}) runs an entry flow. A slug plus {maintenanceModes} edits, backfills or closes the workflow or one slice. `brainstorm` thinks an idea through with you until you say `done`; `simplify` runs three read-only reviewers; `task` is work whose deliverable is not a code change.

keys.name: shape
keys.does: Product-owner discovery. Authors the documentation plan and `augmentations-needed`.
keys.summary: Product-owner discovery: acceptance criteria, documentation plan, augmentations.

keys.name: design
keys.does: Human-only: the person confirms the boards before drivers run.
keys.summary: Human-only design stage between shape and slice: the person confirms the drawings before any driver runs. Also keeps the project's design record (`setup`, `teach`, `extract`, `direction`, `sync`).

keys.name: slice
keys.does: Decompose the shape into shippable slices.
keys.summary: Decomposes the shape into shippable slices.

keys.name: plan
keys.does: Per-slice plan with a reuse scan. Applies the augmentation plan via `reference/augment/<type>.md`.
keys.summary: Per-slice plan with a reuse scan.

keys.name: implement
keys.does: Code the slice. `reviews` runs fix-blockers mode on the selected slice or on the named slice.
keys.summary: Codes the slice. `reviews` runs the fix-blockers mode.

keys.name: verify
keys.does: Tests, lints, typecheck, the user-observable AC gate, one user-gated fix loop, augmentation re-checks.
keys.summary: Tests, lints, typecheck, the user-observable AC gate, one user-gated fix loop.

keys.name: review
keys.does: With a slug: the workflow stage over the accumulating ledger. Without: ad-hoc review, one rubric or a fan-out. Resolves slug versus dimension itself.
keys.summary: Workflow review over an accumulating ledger; ad-hoc rubric or `sweep <aggregate>` without a slug.

keys.name: handoff
keys.does: Aggregate completed slices into a PR. `pr#N` or a branch runs batch mode across the branch onto the lead slug. Refuses while a required review has unresolved blockers.
keys.summary: Aggregates completed slices into a PR. Batch mode over `pr#N` or a branch.

keys.name: ship
keys.does: Release via `.ai/ship-plan.md`. Batch mode is all-or-nothing per PR. `announce` re-runs comms. `rollback [<run-id>]` runs the Go/No-Go reversal.

keys.name: retro
keys.does: Post-mortem. Batch mode retrospects every slug on the branch and the cross-slug lessons.
keys.summary: Post-mortem, per slug or per branch.

keys.name: probe
keys.does: Runtime-truth verification of built work. Target mode compares to AC text. `sweep` enumerates the user surface against AC, charter, and `reference/_surface-defects.md`; as the first token it runs slug-less. Writes no code.
keys.summary: Runtime-truth verification of built work; `sweep` enumerates the user surface.

keys.name: auto
keys.does: Lifecycle driver. Pauses only at a stage's own gate. Stops before handoff.
keys.summary: Lifecycle driver. Pauses only at a stage's own gate. Stops before handoff.

keys.name: yolo
keys.does: Autonomous driver. Resolves each gate by written policy. Stops before handoff.
keys.summary: Autonomous driver. Resolves each gate by written policy.

hosts.codex: gap: not available; no driver runtime runs the yolo script on this host yet
hosts.pi: gap: not available; no driver runtime runs the yolo script on this host yet

keys.name: campaign
keys.does: Walk one work packet at a time: slice, yolo, fidelity, try-out.
keys.summary: Walks the ordered list of work packets that a brainstorm or an ideate pick wrote, one work packet at a time on one branch: slices and yolo-drives each work packet, reads its decision fidelity, and pauses for a try-out when the work packet can be tried. One PR per list, or stacked PRs per work packet.

hosts.codex: gap: the walk stops before the yolo step of each work packet; no driver runtime runs yolo on this host yet
hosts.pi: gap: the walk stops before the yolo step of each work packet; no driver runtime runs yolo on this host yet

keys.name: loop
keys.does: `goal`: the host goal carries the slug, and `goal.mjs check` judges it. `optimize`: a metric loop that keeps or reverts. `prototype`: prove an idea by running code, one round per request of the person.
keys.summary: Three loops. `loop goal` hands a slug to the host goal, and `goal.mjs check` decides that the goal is met. `loop optimize` changes the code toward one metric and keeps or reverts each trial. `loop prototype` proves an idea by running code in its own worktree, one round per request of the person.

hosts.claude: differs: the mod puts the /goal line into the prompt box
hosts.pi: differs: the person pastes the line that goal.mjs arm prints

hosts.codex: gap: not available; the optimize driver runs only on Claude Code
hosts.pi: gap: not available; the optimize driver runs only on Claude Code

keys.name: status
keys.does: Dashboard; per-slug detail with the next command; `INDEX.md` reconciliation; `deep` drift check; `advise` cross-slug sequencing. `recap` tells a workflow's or a branch's story, or explains one artifact.
keys.summary: Dashboard; per-slug detail with the next command; `deep` drift check; `advise` sequencing. `status recap` is the plain-language catch-up for a slug or a branch.

keys.name: project
keys.does: The project-level contracts: author, build, edit, or audit `.ai/ship-plan.md` and `.ai/observability.md`.
keys.summary: The project-level contracts: `project ship-plan` (`init`, `build`, `edit`, `audit` for `.ai/ship-plan.md`) and `project observability` (`init`, `build`, `audit` for `.ai/observability.md`).

keys.name: docs
keys.does: Documentation router: the orchestrator pipeline, or one Diátaxis primitive.
keys.summary: Documentation router: the orchestrator pipeline, or one Diátaxis primitive.

manifest.claude: One command, `/wf` (`$wf` under Codex), the single SDLC entry point for Claude Code and Codex from one plugin tree. It drives {stageCount} stages, from intake through retro, with per-slice artifacts, runtime-truth verification and PO-confirmed stack fingerprinting. {keyCount} keys: {keyList}. Quick and standalone flows are `/wf intake` modes: {entryModes}.
manifest.codexShort: One-command SDLC lifecycle ($wf), from the same tree as the Claude Code plugin
manifest.codex: SDLC workflow plugin, one source for Claude Code and Codex: one `$wf` workflow skill ({keyCount} keys: {keyList}; the intake modes are {entryModes}; {hostGaps}) plus consult, imagery, uiproto, diataxis and study-sources, over the shared .ai/ artifacts. Requires a hooks-GA Codex CLI (verified on 0.146.0) with hooks enabled.
manifest.codexLong: A single-source SDLC plugin that Claude Code and Codex read directly: one $wf workflow skill ({keyCount} keys: {keyList}) and five independent engineering skills (consult, imagery, uiproto, diataxis, study-sources), driving {stageCount} stages with per-slice artifacts and runtime-truth verification. {hostGaps}. Skill prose is host-neutral; the Codex hooks live in hooks/codex.hooks.json. Review and trust the bundled hooks before activation.
manifest.openaiPrompt: Run `$wf intake <description>` to start a new workflow, or `$wf status` to see every workflow and its next command. The intake modes are {entryModes}.
